title: Claiming Universal Credit: claimants' experience at each step (% positive)
caption: Source: DWP Research Report 958, Universal Credit Full Service Survey (2018).

steps.label: Register the claim online
steps.detail: Registered their claim online on their own; a further 21% online with help
steps.pain: A quarter (25%) could not submit their claim online at all
steps.opportunity: Manage expectations upfront: 39% did not know UC is an online, self-service system

steps.label: Complete the online claim
steps.detail: Found the online claim process easy overall
steps.pain: Greatest difficulty: gathering the information and documents needed (32%)

steps.label: Verify identity online
steps.detail: Found verifying their identity online easy
steps.pain: 48% found verifying their identity online difficult
steps.opportunity: More proactive and ongoing support with making and managing a digital claim

steps.label: Call the service centre
steps.detail: Said their enquiry was dealt with well
steps.pain: 26% said their enquiry was not dealt with well

steps.label: Accept the Claimant Commitment
steps.detail: Thought the conditions were explained well

steps.label: Commitment fits my circumstances
steps.detail: Agreed it takes account of their personal circumstances

steps.label: Keep the online journal
steps.detail: Found the journal easy to use

steps.label: Complete the To Do's
steps.detail: Agreed the To Do's tell them what to do in a way they easily understand
steps.pain: 27% struggled to complete their To Do's on time

steps.label: See what I am paid
steps.detail: Agreed the account makes clear what entitlements they are paid for

steps.label: Manage the payments
steps.detail: Felt confident managing their UC payments

steps.label: Keep up with bills
steps.detail: Keeping up with bills and credit commitments about three months into the claim
steps.pain: 44% were falling behind or in real financial difficulty
steps.opportunity: Targeted advice and guidance on budgeting and financial management
